caption:
Location is everything. 📍

SkyHouse is perched above Sayulita — close enough to walk to the beach, the market, and the best taco stands in town, but elevated enough to feel like your own private escape.

Step outside and you're in the heart of one of Mexico's most beloved surf villages. Step back inside and the world melts away.

The best of both worlds, every single day. 🌴

🏖️ 5 min walk to the beach
🌮 Steps from town & restaurants
🛻 Easy access to other breaks & adventures
✈️ 45 min from Puerto Vallarta airport

📍 Sayulita, Nayarit, México
